import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import warnings
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Fixed paths
SUB_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUB_DIR, exist_ok=True)

BASE_DIR = "./input"

TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_PATH = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "sample_submission_null.csv")

print("Loading data...")
df_train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
df_test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_PATH)

print(f"Train shape: {df_train.shape}, Test shape: {df_test.shape}")


def clean_text(text):
    """Clean text by removing quotes and extra whitespace"""
    if pd.isna(text) or str(text).strip() == "" or len(str(text)) > 5000:
        return ""
    s = str(text).strip()
    if s.startswith('"') and s.endswith('"'):
        s = s[1:-1]
    s = " ".join(s.split()).lower()
    return s


train_comments = df_train["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_comments = df_test["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
y_train = df_train["Insult"]

X_train_raw = train_comments.values.astype(object)
X_test_raw = test_comments.values.astype(object)

# Proper stratified split: keep 20% as hold-out validation for internal assessment
X_train_vec, X_val_internal, y_train_split, y_val_hold = train_test_split(
    X_train_raw, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

stop_words = [
    "the",
    "is",
    "and",
    "for",
    "that",
    "but",
    "in",
    "on",
    "at",
    "to",
    "of",
    "a",
    "an",
    "as",
    "be",
    "by",
    "can",
    "do",
    "had",
    "he",
    "his",
    "i",
    "it",
    "me",
    "my",
    "no",
    "not",
    "or",
    "our",
    "she",
    "so",
    "us",
    "very",
    "this",
    "those",
    "they",
    "time",
    "what",
    "where",
    "when",
    "why",
    "who",
    "will",
    "with",
]

# Word features with TF-IDF
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000,
    min_df=2,
    stop_words=stop_words,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    lowercase=True,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)
X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_vec)
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val_internal)
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_test_raw)

# Character n-grams
char_vectorizer = CountVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(1, 3), max_features=8000, min_df=1
)
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_vec)
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val_internal)
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_test_raw)

# Combined features
X_train_final = np.hstack([X_train_word.toarray(), X_train_char.toarray()])
X_val_final = np.hstack([X_val_word.toarray(), X_val_char.toarray()])
X_test_final = np.hstack([X_test_word.toarray(), X_test_char.toarray()])

print(
    f"Features shape - Train: {X_train_final.shape}, Val: {X_val_final.shape}, Test: {X_test_final.shape}"
)

# Ensemble strategy with different seeds
predictions_list = []
model_info = []

seeds = [42, 123, 456, 789, 101112, 202203, 202204, 202301]
learning_rates = [0.01, 0.03, 0.05, 0.08, 0.10, 0.12, 0.15, 0.18]
depths = [4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 14]

for i, seed in enumerate(seeds):
    lr = learning_rates[i % len(learning_rates)]
    depth = depths[i % len(depths)]

    base_model = XGBClassifier(
        n_estimators=150,
        max_depth=depth,
        learning_rate=lr,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        random_state=seed,
        use_label_encoder=False,
        eval_metric="logloss",
        n_jobs=-1,
        verbose=0,
        early_stopping_rounds=20,
        tree_method="hist",
    )

    # Train on full training data including val_split (resubstitution approach for better fit)
    base_model.fit(
        X_train_final,
        y_train_split,
        eval_set=[(X_val_final, y_val_hold)],
        verbose=False,
    )

    # Get predictions for both val and test sets
    val_pred_proba = base_model.predict_proba(X_val_final)[:, 1]
    test_pred_proba = base_model.predict_proba(X_test_final)[:, 1]

    predictions_list.append(test_pred_proba)
    model_info.append(f"Model_{seed}_lr{lr}_d{depth}")

# Average ensemble predictions on test set
ensemble_preds = np.mean(predictions_list, axis=0)
ensemble_preds = np.clip(ensemble_preds, 0.0, 1.0)

# Calculate AUC on hold-out validation set from training data only
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_hold, ensemble_preds[: len(y_val_hold)])
print(f"\n=== Ensemble AUC on Hold-Out Validation Set ===")
print(f"Score: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Ensure submission directory exists
if not os.path.exists(SUB_DIR):
    os.makedirs(SUB_DIR)

# Create submission file with correct column names matching sample template
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Insult": ensemble_preds})
submission_path = os.path.join(SUB_DIR, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)

print(f"\n=== Submission Saved ===")
print(f"File: {submission_path}")
print(f"Shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"AUC on hold-out validation: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Verify submission file exists and has content
assert os.path.exists(
    submission_path
), f"Submission file not created at {submission_path}"
assert len(submission_df) == len(
    df_test
), f"Submission length mismatch: {len(submission_df)} vs {len(df_test)}"
print("\nValidation complete!")
